# M23-S4 (step 20, C3): the logos environment decisions, pinned end to end.
# Each row is a hand-written characterization of the SPEC's logos.toml
# decisions as they reach the environment and the tool invocations: the
# arena experiment, the per-module cgo switch behind -C, the workspace-wide
# arena decision, the wasm preemptibleloops default with its user opt-out,
# the GOAMD64 startup snapshot that lets a user setting beat target_cpu,
# and the -O flag error that preempts a broken logos.toml.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CC=
env CGO_ENABLED=
env GOEXPERIMENT=
env GOAMD64=
env GOARM64=
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
env GOENV=$WORK/userenv
mkdir -p $WORK/out

# [build] arena = true turns the logosarena experiment on for logos env.
cd arena
logos env GOEXPERIMENT
stdout '^logosarena$'
go env GOEXPERIMENT
! stdout 'logosarena'
cd ..

# The cgo switch follows the target module of -C, not the starting one:
# the forbid module bakes 0, the allow module under -C bakes 1.
cd forbid
[cgo] logos env CGO_ENABLED
[cgo] stdout '^0$'
[cgo] logos -C sub env CGO_ENABLED
[cgo] stdout '^1$'
logos env GOEXPERIMENT
! stdout 'logosarena'
cd ..

# A workspace decides once for all members: wa carries arena = true and wb
# carries no key, yet both members compile the experiment-on goexperiment file.
cd w
logos build -a -x -o $WORK/out/wa.bin example.com/wa
stderr 'exp_logosarena_on\.go'
logos build -a -x -o $WORK/out/wb.bin example.com/wb
stderr 'exp_logosarena_on\.go'
cd ..

# wasm builds default to preemptibleloops under logos; an explicit user
# GOEXPERIMENT token is a choice, never a force.
cd wasm
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm
logos env GOEXPERIMENT
stdout '^logosarena,preemptibleloops$'
go env GOEXPERIMENT
! stdout 'preemptibleloops'
env GOEXPERIMENT=nopreemptibleloops
logos env GOEXPERIMENT
stdout '^nopreemptibleloops,logosarena$'
env GOEXPERIMENT=
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
cd ..

# A GOAMD64 written through the GOENV file is a user setting at process
# start, so target_cpu's deterministic default v3 stays out; with no user
# setting the default reaches the tool invocations.
cd opt
logos build -a -x -o $WORK/out/opt1.bin .
stderr 'GOAMD64=.v3.'
go env -w GOAMD64=v1
logos env GOAMD64
stdout '^v1$'
logos build -x -o $WORK/out/opt2.bin .
! stderr 'GOAMD64=.v3.'
cd ..

# The -O flag error is the only output even when logos.toml is broken:
# flag validation happens before the per-package config error is claimed.
cd broken
! logos build -O=bad .
stderr '^logos build: invalid -O level "bad" \(want 0, 1, 2, 3, s\)$'
! stderr 'logos\.toml:'
cd ..

-- arena/go.mod --
module example.com/arena

go 1.27

-- arena/logos.toml --
[build]
arena = true

-- arena/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("arena") }

-- forbid/go.mod --
module example.com/forbid

go 1.27

-- forbid/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- forbid/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("forbid") }

-- forbid/sub/go.mod --
module example.com/forbid/sub

go 1.27

-- forbid/sub/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- forbid/sub/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("sub") }

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	../wa
	../wb
)

-- wa/go.mod --
module example.com/wa

go 1.27

-- wa/logos.toml --
[build]
arena = true

-- wa/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("wa") }

-- wb/go.mod --

-- wb/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("wb") }

-- wasm/go.mod --
module example.com/wasmmod

go 1.27

-- wasm/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("wasm") }

-- opt/go.mod --
module example.com/optenv

go 1.27

-- opt/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("opt") }

-- broken/go.mod --
module example.com/brokenopt

go 1.27

-- broken/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow

-- broken/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("broken") }
